t: Focal Logistics Group awarded ISO certification
html:
Focal Logistics Group has been awarded ISO 9001:2015 certification, marking an important milestone following the recent consolidation of the group and reaffirming its commitment to consistent, high-quality service across all its operations.

ISO 9001:2015 is an internationally recognised standard for quality management systems. The certification confirms that Focal Logistics Group has implemented structured processes focused on operational efficiency, risk management, customer satisfaction and continuous improvement. It also demonstrates the group’s ability to deliver services that consistently meet customer and regulatory requirements.

The certification follows the consolidation of the group’s member companies under a unified structure, ensuring that the same quality principles, procedures and performance benchmarks apply across the entire organisation. While each member company retains its operational strengths and sector expertise, the ISO framework provides a common approach to quality assurance and service delivery.

Anton Xerri, CEO of the Group, said: “The certification reflects the same commitment to reliability, professionalism and service excellence for which its companies, Focal Maritime Services, Delta Container Services Company Limited and GreenwaveShipping.mt are already well regarded. It also provides clients and partners with added assurance that quality standards are monitored, measured and continually improved. The certification supports its long-term strategy of strengthening governance, improving internal coordination and delivering value-driven logistics solutions in an increasingly demanding operating environment.”
